findings.title: serve_glow.py phuc vu CA thu muc repo qua HTTP nen `GET /.env` tra ve nguyen file key that
findings.boundary: HTTP cuc bo -> file system (repo root)
findings.exploit: Chay `python serve_glow.py` (mac dinh :8765) roi `GET /.env` => 200, Content-Length 29.804 = dung bang size `.env`, kieu `application/octet-stream`. Lay duoc BINANCE_API_KEY/SECRET (quyen futures), BINANCE_LIVE_*, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN => tu mo/dong lenh va dieu khien bot qua Telegram. Neu chay `--host 0.0.0.0` (co tham so nay) thi ca LAN doc duoc. Da do lai sau khi sua: 404.
findings.impact: key giao dich that + token bot; khong rut duoc tien (key futures khong co quyen withdrawal) nhung lenh trai phep thi co
findings.guard: Handler.translate_path() chan theo ten: `.env*`, `id_rsa*`, `id_ed25519*`, `.git`, `.npmrc`, `.netrc` va cac thu muc `logs/`, `__pycache__/`, `.venv/`, `node_modules/` -> tra 404. `--host` khac loopback thi in canh bao rang POST khong co token.

findings.title: telegram_bridge: danh sach chat_id cho phep RONG thi lai cho QUA (fail-open)
findings.exploit: Dieu kien cu chi chan khi danh sach CO phan tu. Instance/clone khong khai `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` lan `TELEGRAM_ALLOW_CHAT_IDS` => ai nhan tin cho bot cung duoc xu ly: `/status` chay `tools/ops.py` va gui lai vi the/equity, `/ask` ghi vao hang doi; neu `TELEGRAM_ALLOW_WRITE=true` (ca 2 instance dang bat) thi `/restart live`, `/reset live confirm` chay duoc. Docstring cua `poll()` noi nguoc lai ("chat_id la bi BO QUA") nen khong ai phat hien.
findings.impact: lo trang thai bot cho nguoi la + dieu khien duoc lenh GHI neu cau hinh thieu; tren may hien tai 2 instance deu co chat_id nen chua khai thac duoc, nhung ban clone/instance moi thi co

evidence.pattern: if not allow or cid not in allow:

evidence.absent: if allow and cid not in allow

findings.guard: Dao dieu kien thanh fail-closed (`not allow or ...`), ghi log ro "danh sach cho phep: RONG", khong tra loi nguoi la.

findings.title: vscode_lm_bridge: token tuy chon (mac dinh KHONG co) va dung chung cong 8765 voi serve_glow
findings.boundary: process cuc bo -> phieu hoi dong (nguon 'Copilot')
findings.exploit: `extension.js:53` chi kiem tra Authorization khi `token` khac rong, ma cau hinh mac dinh la `token: ""` => moi process tren may goi duoc `/complete`. Cong mac dinh 8765 trung voi `serve_glow.py`, nen mot process cuc bo bind 8765 truoc se dong vai 'LLM' va tra JSON phieu bat ky => bom phieu vao hoi dong (co the lam tat veto hoac veto moi lenh).
findings.impact: hoi dong la shadow/veto; do 11/11 veto 'bang chung nguoc dau' nen quyen veto thuc te = 0 => tac dong tien = 0 hom nay, nhung se co tac dong khi bat quyen veto
findings.guard: Da chap nhan (khong sua): bridge chi listen 127.0.0.1, phieu khong mang quyen dat size/SL. **Da tach cong 15/11**: `serve_glow.py` mac dinh **8770** (truoc 8765) de khong gianh cong voi bridge. Dieu kien con lai: **neu bat quyen veto cho hoi dong thi PHAI dat token** (`AGENT_VSCODE_LM_TOKEN`).

findings.title: Token Telegram bi ghi vao log khi loi mang (loi chua nguyen URL Bot API)
findings.exploit: `urllib3`/`requests` nem loi dang `Max retries exceeded with url: /bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage`; code cu ghi thang `str(e)` (`notify.py`, `tools/telegram_bridge.py:api_call`) va `api_call` tra `error` -> `logs/telegram_bridge.log`. Chi can 1 lan timeout la token nam trong log, roi log bi copy/dan len issue la mat bot.
findings.impact: lo token bot (bot gui duoc tin nhan, khong doc duoc lich su cu); `logs/` da bi git-ignore nen khong lo ra GitHub
findings.guard: `notify.redact()` va `telegram_bridge.redact()` thay `/bot<so>:<chuoi>` bang `/bot<token>` truoc khi log.

findings.title: state_sync ghi cap key LIVE vao `.env` bang code (khong backup, khong hoi)
findings.boundary: tool -> file cau hinh chua bi mat
findings.exploit: `state_sync.py:410-411` dat `BINANCE_API_KEY`/`BINANCE_API_SECRET` = cap key LIVE. Chay nham instance la bot TESTNET cam key that; truoc khi sua F-01 thi cap key do con bi phuc vu qua HTTP.
findings.impact: khong phai lo hong tu than, nhung la duong khuech dai: 1 loi chon instance -> key that nam trong file duoc serve/copy
findings.guard: Da chap nhan: `.env` bi git-ignore (C-02), F-01 da chan HTTP; truoc khi chay `state_sync --to-live` phai xem lai `.env` 2 lan.

findings.title: restart_bot kill PID doc tu file state (`taskkill /F /T /PID <pid>`)
findings.boundary: file state cuc bo -> tien trinh he thong
findings.exploit: `tools/restart_bot.py:69` lay `pid` tu `logs/supervisor.pid` (hoac tham so) roi `taskkill /F /T` — file bi sua tay thi kill duoc process khac. Khong co shell nen khong tiem lenh.
findings.impact: DoS cuc bo; can quyen ghi file trong repo
findings.guard: Da chap nhan: argv co dinh (khong shell), chi nguoi van hanh chay. Muon chat hon: doi chieu `pid` voi `tasklist` + ten `pythonw.exe` truoc khi kill.

controls.what: Khong co sink thuc thi code trong code san xuat: eval/exec/os.system/pickle.load/yaml.load/shell=True
Khong commit bi mat: `.env` va `logs/` bi git-ignore
Moi server HTTP cua bot chi listen loopback (127.0.0.1)
Interlock LIVE truoc moi vong trade: LIVE_CONFIRM=true + n>=50 + PF>=1.2 + risk<=2% + lev<=10 + kill-switch sach
